text: I think you'll really enjoy this recipe, Rosemary Chicken Salad Sandwiches, given your liking for chicken and salads. The dish is also a great fit for your health goal of lowering your sodium intake, as it contains a relatively low amount of salt compared to many other recipes. Additionally, the ingredients are well-balanced and provide a good mix of protein, healthy fats, and complex carbohydrates, making it a nutritious and filling option. The preparation time is also quick, which fits within your 45-minute time budget.
